description: This file implements a test stub class 'ClientStub' for IPC communication testing, including methods for connecting, disconnecting, sending requests, handling events, and managing message threads, primarily used in unit tests with Google Test framework.

classes.name: ClientStub
classes.description: A test stub class for IPC client communication, providing methods to connect, disconnect, send requests, handle events, and manage message threads for testing purposes.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes IPC channel connection, subscribes to test events, and initializes the test module stub.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Unsubscribes from events and disconnects the IPC channel.

methods.name: sendSingleVarRequest
methods.description: Sends a request with a single variable and waits for a response.

methods.name: sendSingleVarRequestWithNoReply
methods.description: Sends a request expecting no reply and waits for completion.

methods.name: sendMultiVarRequest
methods.description: Sends a request with multiple variables and waits for a response.

methods.name: sendRequestWithSingleVarResponse
methods.description: Sends a request and retrieves a single variable response.

methods.name: sendRequestWithMultiVarResponse
methods.description: Sends a request and retrieves multiple variables in response.

methods.name: startMessageThread
methods.description: Starts a thread to process incoming messages and verify expected message receipt.

methods.name: waitForSingleVarEvent
methods.description: Waits for a single variable event to be received.

methods.name: waitForMultiVarEvent
methods.description: Waits for a multi-variable event to be received.

methods.name: onTestEventSingleVarReceived
methods.description: Callback invoked when a single variable test event is received.

methods.name: onTestEventMultiVarReceived
methods.description: Callback invoked when a multi-variable test event is received.
